direction.name: The name as a monument
direction.idea: The name is the headline. Set it so large that it becomes architecture: as wide as the viewport, cropped by an edge, or stacked to fill the screen. Nothing else on the first screen competes; the description of what this is drops to a single small sentence. The idea comes from treating the name's letters as material. Ask what the subject can do to its own name: a photograph of the work sits inside a counter or replaces a letter, the name repeats down the page like a reel, the letters are split to opposite corners and the page happens between them. In the study this was the single most common device among sites scoring 7.5 or more.
direction.composition: First screen: the wordmark spans 88–100% of the viewport width (font-size 16–24vw, set with a clamp so it never wraps), anchored either to the bottom edge with its descenders nearly touching it, or dead centre with everything else pushed to the corners. One line of supporting text at 16–20px sits in a corner on a shared margin; navigation is three or four words in the opposite corner. After the hero the page is deliberately small and calm: a narrow text column or a simple two-column grid, so the contrast with the monument holds. The name returns once more at full width as the footer, in the inverse colours. Margins are tight (20–32px) so the type reaches the edges. Two type sizes do nearly all the work: the monument and a small text size, with one mid size for section headings.
direction.typography: One family. The display cut must survive enormous sizes: tight tracking (-0.04 to -0.07em), leading 0.8–0.9, optical kerning on. Section headings are modest (28–40px) on purpose.
direction.colour: Two values carry the page (ground and ink). The accent, if used at all, appears on one thing only: the single action or the inset image frame. The footer inverts ground and ink.
direction.imagery: Few images, used as inserts in the typography rather than as illustrations beside it: one photograph inside or behind the name (a 4:5 or 1:1 frame replacing a letter, or tucked between two words), then a short run of large full-width or half-width photographs further down. Square corners. No collage of small thumbnails.
direction.richness: Scale. The size of the name against the smallness of everything else is the entire visual event, so protect both ends: do not shrink the name to make room, and do not let body text creep above 20px.
direction.pitfalls: A long name set small is just a logo. If the name has more than about 12 characters, stack it on two lines or crop it with the viewport edge; never drop below 12vw. Do not add a second big headline under the name. Do not decorate the letters.

hero.name: Film title, bottom edge
hero.blueprint: One photograph fills the viewport at 100vw by 100svh, `object-fit: cover`, with its subject in the upper two-thirds and a calmer, darker zone along the bottom. The name is one condensed uppercase word, or a short name in a high-contrast serif, set at clamp(150px, 17.5vw, 290px) and sized to span the full width between 32px margins. It is centred and anchored so its baseline sits 34px above the bottom edge, covering roughly the lowest quarter of the frame. A soft neutral dark scrim lies under that bottom band only, about 40% of the height; the rest of the image is untouched. Directly above the name's left end, on the same margin, sits the supporting sentence at 16px on two short lines. Directly above its right end, right-aligned, sits the single action as a small paper-coloured rectangular button. The top edge carries a small emblem or wordmark at the left margin and up to five text links at 15px grouped at the right, all in white. The central half of the screen belongs to the view.
hero.mobile: The photograph is re-cropped to portrait with `object-position` on its subject and fills 100svh. The name stays on the bottom edge at 22vw on one line, or two lines at 20vw beyond eight characters, 20px above the edge. The supporting sentence sits above the name's left end at 15px. The action button moves to the top-right corner and the links collapse to a menu word beside the emblem.
hero.headline: The name of the place: one word of up to about 12 characters at 17.5vw, or two words stacked on a phone.

type.note: A broad black grotesque with a slightly uneven rhythm, at its best as a name set very large in mixed case. Suits entertainers, podcasts, consumer apps and blunt SaaS pages; emphasis comes from colour, not from a change of weight.

palette.name: Graphite and orange
palette.note: Graphite and cool light-grey sections alternate, graphite taking about two thirds, and photographs are desaturated so nothing competes. Safety orange marks the buttons, one thick solid bar across the top of the page and the highlighted item in a list or chart.

motion.name: Slow crossfade
motion.description: The principal photograph quietly changes: three or four images of the same framing crossfade over about 1.6 seconds, holding five to six seconds each, or the fixed image changes when its matching section arrives. It should feel like light shifting in a room. Pause when the tab is hidden; under reduced motion show only the first image.

sections.name: Portrait as drop cap
sections.blueprint: No heading. One biography paragraph of 50–80 words is set large at clamp(24px, 2.5vw, 38px), regular weight, leading 1.2, across columns 3–12 of the grid. A square portrait is floated at the paragraph's start with `float: left`: its side equals three lines of text (3.6em), with 0.5em of space to its right, so the first three lines wrap beside it and the fourth returns to the paragraph's left edge, like a drop capital. Square corners. The person's name, the first words of the paragraph, is in full ink; the rest may be in a softer ink with linked names in full ink and underlined. A second paragraph follows after one blank line in the soft ink at the same size. Columns 1–2 hold three short facts (place, since when, how to reach) at 14px, top-aligned with the portrait. Section padding 140px.
sections.mobile: Text at 22px with leading 1.25, full width. The portrait keeps its float but grows to four lines tall, about 110px square. The three facts move below the second paragraph as a single row of three small blocks at 13px.

sections.name: One plan as a sentence
sections.blueprint: The whole offer is one sentence of five to seven short words that contains the price, set at 8–9vw across the full width on two lines, leading 0.95, flush left; it replaces any heading. The price is not styled as a different word. Instead it sits on a filled block of the accent colour exactly one line-height tall with 0.15em of padding at each side, so the figure reads as an object in the line. Below, on one shared baseline 64px under the sentence: a supporting sentence at 20px in columns 1–6 saying what the price includes, and one rectangular button right-aligned in columns 10–12. If a second option exists (annual, team), it is a plain text link under the button, not a second panel. The section is one flat colour field at least 80svh tall.
sections.mobile: The sentence is set at 11vw on two lines, with the price block on a line of its own between them, as wide as its figure. The supporting sentence follows at 17px, then a full-width button, then the text link for the second option.

sections.name: Small frames, wide space
sections.blueprint: A flat, quiet viewport 100svh tall in which about 70% of the screen is empty. At mid-height a single row of small portrait frames runs across and off both sides: each frame 11vw wide and 24svh tall (roughly 2:3), spaced 5vw apart, vertically centred, six or seven visible at 1440. Frames have square corners and sit directly on the ground with no border. The row scrolls sideways by drag or trackpad (`overflow-x: auto` with the scrollbar hidden) and may hold 12–24 frames. One line of text overlaps the top-left of the first frame by 12px: a title of two or three words at 20–24px followed by the count, placed above the frame in the stacking order. Hovering a frame scales it to 1.1 from its centre over 250ms; nothing else moves. No captions under frames, no arrows, and no other text in the section.
sections.mobile: The row sits at 45% of an 80svh section. Frames are 34vw wide at 2:3 and 5vw apart, so two and a half are visible and the row scrolls by touch with snapping. The title line sits 20px above the row at the left margin.

sections.name: Loose scatter with pauses
sections.blueprint: One word as heading at 32–40px, top-left on the margin. Projects then appear one at a time down the page, each a single photograph at its own width and side, with 22–30vh of empty ground between them. Use a repeating set of three placements on the 12-column grid: columns 1–6 hugging the left margin at 3:2; columns 9–12 hugging the right margin at 4:5, starting 80px above where the previous image ended so the two overlap in height; columns 3–9 inset at 16:9. Above each image's top-left corner, the project name at 13px in the soft ink; beneath its bottom-left corner, a one-line description at clamp(15px, 1.1vw, 17px) in full ink. Once, in the gap beside the narrow right-hand image, a two-line remark at 20px sits alone in columns 2–5. Square corners. Holds five to eight projects; more belongs in a denser index.
sections.mobile: Images alternate widths against alternating margins: 100%, 68% right, 82% left, with 72px between projects. The name above and the description below each image stay left-aligned to that image's edge. The two-line remark sits full width between the second and third project.

sections.name: Large questions, answers beside
sections.blueprint: Every answer is open; nothing collapses. Each question-and-answer pair is a row on the 12-column grid: the question in columns 1–6 at clamp(26px, 2.6vw, 40px), medium weight, leading 1.1, no more than two lines; its answer in columns 8–12 at 17–18px with leading 1.55 and a measure near 40ch, its first baseline level with the question's first baseline. Rows are separated by 72–88px of empty space and nothing else. Five to seven rows. The section heading, two or three words, is set at the same size as the questions but in the softer ink and sits as the first row's left cell with an empty right cell, so it reads as the top of the same table rather than a title above it. Because questions are large and answers small, the left column works as a scannable index.
sections.mobile: Each pair stacks: question at 24px, answer 12px beneath at 17px, then 56px of space before the next. The heading leads at the same 24px in the softer ink. Answers stay open; there is no accordion on the phone either.

sections.name: Address in display rows
sections.blueprint: The contact block is a stack of five full-width rows, every one set at the same size, clamp(44px, 6vw, 88px), regular weight, left-aligned with a 20px inset and leading 1.0: the building or venue name, the street, the city with postcode, the opening hours as one compact line, the phone number. Each row is about 150px tall with the text sitting in its lower third; rows are told apart by alternating two flat tones of the section colour as full-width bands, or by 28px of space alone. A sixth row holds a one-word greeting at the same size followed, 24px to its right and centred on the x-height, by a solid round button 0.9em across with an arrow, which opens the email or booking link. Street and phone rows are links (map, call). No heading and no form. Optionally, one small round photograph sits at the right end of the first row.
sections.mobile: Rows at 9.6vw with 16px insets, about 84px tall; the hours break onto two rows (days, then times). The greeting row becomes a full-width band in the accent colour with the round arrow button at its right end, 56px across.

sections.name: Invitation over a cropped name
sections.blueprint: Close and footer in one full-viewport field of the inverse colour. Upper third, columns 1–7: a two-line invitation at about 5vw, three to five words, with one filled rectangular button beneath it. At columns 10–12, top-aligned with the invitation, three or four social or contact links stacked at 16px. The wordmark fills the bottom of the screen at 26–30vw on one line, `white-space: nowrap`, heavier and larger than the viewport can hold: it is pushed down with `transform: translateY(30%)` so the bottom edge cuts through the letters, and a long name also runs off the right edge. `overflow: hidden` on the footer does the cropping. One row of credits and legal links at 13px sits directly above the wordmark's cap line, spread left and right. The cropped name must be recognisable from its upper two-thirds alone; test that it is.
sections.mobile: Invitation at 11vw on two lines at the top with a full-width button. Links follow as one row of words at 15px. The wordmark sits at 34vw at the bottom, cropped by both the bottom and the right edge, with the legal row above it at 12px.

references.name: Nia Creative
references.idea: The three-letter wordmark becomes a slot-machine reel: the name repeats vertically and its middle letter is swapped for a square of client photography or video.
references.hero: Pale grey field with a slim nav: bracketed lowercase logo top-left, four uppercase mono links centred, a black pill button top-right. The centre 43% of the width holds a vertical reel of the wordmark stacked three times in very heavy black grotesk, each row about 230px tall; in every row the middle letter is replaced by a square photo or video tile (surfers, a woman holding glasses over her eyes, a burger). The middle row is sharp; rows above and below fade out through gradient masks. A bottom strip carries a mono descriptor at left and city plus live clock at right. A plum band starts at the fold.
references.type: A heavy, tightly tracked grotesk (xgnl) carries the wordmark, a 70px lowercase section word and bold 20 to 34px statements; body is the same face at 14px, bold. Geist Mono in small capitals handles nav, categories, bracketed indexes and the clock.
references.colour: #f3f3f3 #574d56 #515144 #1c1c1c #b9aebd #b3b586 — Pale grey base with black type. Two muted full-width bands, dusty plum and olive, set their text in a lighter tint of the band colour rather than white. Photography supplies the saturation.
references.imagery: Flash-lit hospitality and lifestyle photography plus short video: cocktails, hotel rooms, food, trail runners. Portrait tiles with one or two large rounded corners, square tiles inside the wordmark, and an edge-to-edge three-up strip.
references.layout: 28px side margins and a three-column grid for work. Big lowercase section words sit flush left with a small paragraph flush right. Sections alternate pale grey grids, coloured statement bands and full-bleed image strips; a black rounded nav bar pins to the top after the hero.

sections.description: Dusty plum band about one viewport tall. A bold 34px statement in pale lilac sits top-left across half the width, one phrase underlined with a hand-drawn stroke. Lower left, a small heading and eight industries in tiny uppercase mono split into two bulleted columns. At the right margin a tall portrait photo, about 20% of the width, with large rounded corners, overlaps the band's top edge and leaves the middle of the band empty.

A 70px heavy lowercase word flush left with a three-line 14px paragraph flush right on the same baseline. Below, three equal columns with wide gutters: each has a portrait image narrower than its column with a large radius on the bottom-right corner only, then a 20px project name, a mono uppercase category and a four-line bold description. Rows repeat with no dividers or card backgrounds.

Three photographs or clips butt together edge to edge with no gaps, each a third of the viewport wide and about 40% of a screen tall. Immediately below, an olive band: a three-line 26px statement in pale olive at left with one underlined phrase, two lines of small copy beneath it, and a small rounded portrait image tucked into the lower right corner.

Services as stacked sheets. Each is a full-width panel with a 1px outline and large top-corner radius that slides up over the previous one. The left half is empty except for a centred column: a bracketed mono index, a 26px bold title and four centred lines of sub-services. The right half is one photograph with rounded corners filling the panel height.

steal: Drop a photo tile into the wordmark in place of one letter and run the lockup as a vertical reel with masked top and bottom rows.
On coloured bands, set type in a lighter tint of the band's own hue instead of white to keep the band calm.
Round only one corner of each image tile, the same corner every time, as a quiet signature shape.

references.name: Kereliott
references.idea: A quiet house gets a quiet page: one dark field, one typeface, the name set as wide as the screen and photographs left to drift in generous darkness.
references.hero: Very dark green-black field with cream type. A two-line introductory sentence at about 30px sits top-left inside 30px margins; a small cream rectangular button sits top-right. The upper half is otherwise empty. The house name fills the full content width in a flared humanist sans, mixed case, with capitals about 19vw tall, its baseline at roughly 87% of the viewport height. Immediately beneath, separated by a gap of a few pixels, the top sliver of a full-width landscape photograph enters from the bottom edge.
references.type: A single face, Trust, in regular weight: a humanist sans with flared terminals and old-style figures. The wordmark is an oversized graphic; all other text is one size of about 20-30px plus tiny 10px photo captions. Hierarchy is position, not weight.
references.colour: #161c1a #eae8dc #222926 #1f2926 — Cream on green-black from top to bottom with no accent colour. The map is drawn in a tone barely lighter than the ground, so photographs supply all the colour.
references.imagery: Natural-light photos of a stone cottage, garden and deck with square corners, in mixed portrait and landscape crops at differing sizes. One full-width opener, then small images placed singly with tiny captions under the left corner.
references.layout: 30px margins, text held to the left 60% in one size. Photographs are staggered left and right at different widths with large dark gaps between, like pictures passed on a wall. The name and a booking button stay fixed in the top corners.

sections.description: A full-width landscape photograph runs margin to margin directly under the wordmark, followed after a gap by a four-line paragraph in the single text size, left-aligned and spanning about 85% of the width. There is no heading or label; the text simply continues the sentence begun at the top of the page.

After a left-aligned paragraph, a silhouette map of the region sits centre-left, about half the viewport wide, filled in a green only a few percent lighter than the background. Five towns are marked with small ring dots and tiny labels; only the house's town has a solid cream dot. No border, legend or frame.

Photographs are placed one or two per screen in a stagger: a portrait image about 30% wide against the left margin, a larger near-square one starting lower against the right margin, later a landscape image top-right of centre and a smaller one bottom-left. Each has a 10px caption under its left corner. More than half of every screen is empty dark ground.

Two short left-aligned sentences in the standard text size with underlined inline links to booking platforms and an email address, then a small cream certification badge. The footer is a single line at the very bottom: social link left, copyright centre, three underlined utility links right, with a tall empty gap above.

steal: Size the wordmark to fill the content width exactly and let the first photograph tuck directly under its baseline.
Draw a location map as a tone-on-tone silhouette with one filled dot among ring dots.
Use a single typeface in one weight and essentially one text size, creating hierarchy through placement and emptiness.

references.name: Eagle’s Nest
references.idea: Let the lake view do the selling: full-bleed footage of the volcano horizon with the name set as a monumental cream serif along the bottom edge.
references.hero: Full-bleed video of a silhouetted figure meditating before a lake and volcanoes, with no scrim. The name is set in a high-contrast cream serif, uppercase, about 15vw, spanning the full width between 34px margins and sitting on the bottom edge so it covers the lower fifth of the frame. Directly above its left and right ends sit two pairs of small white labels (what it is, where it is). Top row: a round emblem far left, eight plain text links grouped right of centre and an outlined pill button far right. A small black vertical awards tab hangs on the right edge.
references.type: PP Pangaia medium: uppercase at 216px for the wordmark, mixed case with uncial-flavoured alternates for section titles. PP Neue Montreal for nav and body at 16px, with a lead paragraph near 22px. Two faces and about four sizes.
references.colour: #fffae7 #0e2404 #3f6f8c #2d5c8a #5d9aa3 #040303 — Photography supplies lake blues and timber browns. Content sits on warm cream with deep green or lake-blue serif headings, and the footer inverts to very dark forest green with cream type.
references.imagery: Wide landscape video and saturated photos of the lake, bamboo structures and yoga; full-bleed for scene-setters, otherwise inset cards with a small radius. A flat teal vector map of Central America sits beside the main photo.
references.layout: Thirty screens alternating pinned full-bleed photographs with cream content bands. Tight 17-34px outer margins; content is left-anchored with images running to the right margin, and value chapters use centred titles. The recurring serif holds the long page together.

sections.description: A cream band slides up over the hero. A dark green serif heading at about 4vw sits top-left, followed by a three-line lead paragraph near 22px across half the width. Below, a wide landscape photo card takes about 70% of the width with a short white paragraph overlaid in its top-right corner. To its right is a narrower teal map card with one location dot, and beneath it four tiny label and value pairs, including live local time.

A large blue serif title centred on cream shrinks into a small centred label pinned just above a full-bleed photograph. The photo stays fixed while single value words appear one at a time at its centre in white serif at about 4vw, each with two lines of small centred text beneath. One image carries several sequential captions.

Very dark green field. The top row is split in three: postal address in small sans at left, the section menu as a column of serif links at about 24px starting at the centre line, and social links right-aligned at the far right. The wordmark repeats at full width along the bottom edge at hero size, caught rising letter by letter. Tiny credits sit beneath.

steal: Anchor the name at full width on the bottom edge of a full-bleed video and tuck two tiny descriptor pairs above its left and right ends.
Pin one photograph and cycle one-word captions over it instead of building a card for each value.
Place a small facts stack (elevation, temperature, live local time) beside a flat map to ground a destination.
